curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach who counts as a pedestrian and crosswalk priority, then the protections for blind users, children, driveway crossers and hidden crossers
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on pedestrian types, crosswalk priority, never rushing and brake-tap shields
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on who is a pedestrian, who owns crosswalks and how to shield a hidden crosser

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach bicyclists' rights and the three-foot pass, then passing and turning rules, then full-lane cases, then stops and signals for cyclists
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on three feet, squeezing, horn use, full-lane cases and stop-sign versus red-light rules
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on passing room, merging before right turns, when riders take the lane and how cyclists handle reds

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach why cars hit motorcycles and the full-lane rule, then passing, following and lane changes, then intersections, nights and weather
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on the two-thirds figure, lane width, the M endorsement, three seconds and dimmed lights
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on why crashes happen, lane sharing, trailing time and night lighting

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach truck blind zones and following, then passing and meeting trucks, then wide turns and backing rigs
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on blind zones, rollback gaps, blink announcements, twin trailers and curb gaps
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on the rear blind zone, downgrade passing, meeting far right and the curb gap

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach why trains always win, then the halt distances and triggers, then crossing hardware, then traps and stalls, then buses and judgment
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on stopping distance, fifty and fifteen feet, each device, the twenty-second evacuation and bus halts
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on who is at fault, halt distances, what lights demand, how to escape a stall and why passing is banned

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: teach the farm rigs and animal-drawn vehicles on rural roads, then the SMV emblem
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: one-fact visible-answer cards on farm rigs, animal-drawn rights and the SMV emblem
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: module quiz on rural crawlers, animal-drawn vehicles and what the emblem marks
